# Elements of Theology

*[Proclus](../philosophers/proclus.md) · *Stoicheiōsis theologikē**

A treatise by [Proclus](../philosophers/proclus.md) setting out [Neoplatonic](../movements/neoplatonism.md) metaphysics in 211 propositions demonstrated in the manner of Euclid, from the One down to souls. Through its Arabic reworking, the *Liber de causis*, it fed medieval thought.
